prompt:

explanation: Enormous = huge: rất lớn. Tiny mang nghĩa ngược lại.

prompt: My brother is very reliable. You can always count on him.
explanation: Reliable = dependable: đáng tin cậy. Count on someone = tin cậy ai.

prompt: Which word is the OPPOSITE of generous?
explanation: Generous là hào phóng; trái nghĩa là selfish (ích kỷ).

prompt: Choose the correct collocation: We need to ______ a decision before Friday.
explanation: Cụm cố định là make a decision: đưa ra quyết định.

prompt: Which word does NOT belong in the group?
explanation: Compass là la bàn, một dụng cụ; ba từ còn lại chỉ hiện tượng thiên nhiên nguy hiểm.

prompt: The teacher asked us to ______ our essays for spelling mistakes before handing them in.
explanation: Proofread = đọc soát lỗi, phù hợp với spelling mistakes.

prompt: Choose the word with the correct spelling.
explanation: Necessary viết với một c và hai s. Mẹo: one collar, two sleeves.

prompt: The old castle was abandoned many years ago. Abandoned means:
explanation: Abandoned = bị bỏ hoang, không còn người ở.

prompt: Which idiom means 'to be very happy'?
explanation: Over the moon = rất vui. Under the weather = không khỏe.

prompt: Sarah felt ______ when she saw the spider crawling towards her.
explanation: Terrified = rất sợ hãi, phù hợp phản ứng khi thấy nhện bò tới.

prompt: By the time we arrived at the station, the train ______.
explanation: Hành động tàu rời xảy ra trước lúc chúng tôi đến trong quá khứ: had already left.

prompt: If it ______ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
explanation: Điều kiện loại 1: If + hiện tại đơn, will + động từ. Chủ ngữ it nên rains.

prompt: Neither the students nor the teacher ______ aware of the change in schedule.
explanation: Neither…nor: động từ theo chủ ngữ gần nhất. The teacher số ít nên was.

prompt: This is the boy ______ bicycle was stolen yesterday.
explanation: Whose diễn tả sở hữu: chiếc xe đạp của cậu bé.

prompt: She has been learning the piano ______ five years.
explanation: For + khoảng thời gian (five years); since + mốc thời gian.

prompt: 'Where did you buy that hat?' she asked. → She asked me ______.
choices: where did I buy that hat
where I had bought that hat
where had I bought that hat

prompt: The homework ______ by all students before Monday.
explanation: Bị động với động từ khuyết thiếu: must + be + quá khứ phân từ → must be finished.

prompt: Tom is ______ than his brother, but his brother is ______ student in the class.
explanation: So sánh hai người: taller than. So sánh nhất trong cả lớp: the best.

prompt: I look forward to ______ from you soon.
explanation: Trong look forward to, to là giới từ nên theo sau bởi V-ing: hearing.

prompt: Why did William have to leave school?
choices: He was not interested in studying.
His family could not pay the fees after the drought.
The school was closed because of the drought.
He wanted to work in the library.
explanation: Đoạn đầu nói hạn hán khiến mùa màng thất bát và gia đình không trả nổi học phí.
passage:
When William Kamkwamba was fourteen years old, a terrible drought hit his village in Malawi, a
small country in southern Africa. The crops failed, food became scarce, and William's family could
no longer afford his school fees. Instead of giving up, William went to the small village library and
taught himself from old science books. One book, called Using Energy, had a picture of a windmill
on its cover. William realised that a windmill could pump water for the fields and produce
electricity for his home.
He began collecting scrap materials: a broken bicycle, plastic pipes, an old tractor fan and some
wire. Many villagers laughed at him and called him crazy. But after months of work, William
climbed his wooden tower, connected the wires, and a small light bulb began to glow. It was the
first electric light his village had ever seen.


News of the windmill spread quickly. Journalists came to visit, and William was invited to speak at
conferences around the world. He later received a scholarship and graduated from an American
university. Today, William helps other young people in Africa build their own inventions. "If you
want to make it, all you have to do is try," he says.

choices: From a book in the library

explanation: William thấy hình cối xay gió trên bìa sách Using Energy ở thư viện.

prompt: Who can take part in the Summer Reading Challenge?
choices: Students who have a library card
explanation: Thông báo ghi rõ readers aged 8–13.
passage:
GREENWOOD PUBLIC LIBRARY – SUMMER READING CHALLENGE 2026
Calling all readers aged 8–13! Join our Summer Reading Challenge and win exciting prizes.
How it works
1. Register at the front desk or online at www.greenwoodlibrary.org by 15 June.
2. Read at least six books between 20 June and 20 August.
3. For each book you finish, write a short review (50–100 words) in your Reading Passport.
4. Hand in your Passport by 25 August.
Prizes
• 6 books: a certificate and a Greenwood bookmark
• 10 books: certificate + a £10 book voucher
• 15 books or more: certificate + voucher + an invitation to our Author Day on 5 September, where


you can meet children's author Maya Lindqvist and get your book signed.
Please note: Comics and graphic novels count as one book each. Audiobooks are accepted, but
only up to three. Late Passports will not be accepted. For more information, ask a librarian or
email reading@greenwoodlibrary.org.
